system.name: Cure Light Wounds Rev
system.description:
This spell cures one living (not undead or non-living) creature of 1d6+1 points of damage. The caster can cure themselves with this spell.

Alternatively, the spell can be used to cure paralysis (except that caused by a Hold Person or Hold Monster spell), although if it does so then no damage will be cured at the same time.

Reverse: Cause Light Wounds inflicts 1d6+1 damage to a touched living (not undead or non-living) target. The target gets no save against the damage, but the caster must make a normal attack roll to touch an unwilling target.
